sheets.title: Project Overview
rows: Duy Tan University - School of Computer Science - CMU-SE 450
Scam Fraud Detection System with Explanations (SFDS)
FastAPI (Python 3.12), React 18 (Vite), PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, Tesseract OCR, SQLite/MySQL
Architecture Setup, Domain Gating, PhishVN & ResNet-18 baseline
OCR Engine, Risk Keyword Engine, Calibrated Consensus Fusion
React Scan Interface, Reasoning Visualizer, History & Feedback
Admin Intelligence Dashboard, Whitelist/Blacklist Manager, Report Export
End-to-End Stress Testing, Security Hardening, Capstone Final Defense

sheets.title: Product Backlog
rows: set up FastAPI backend framework, Vite React frontend, and database schema ORM
the development team has a unified, stable environment to build multimodal detection modules.

- FastAPI app initialized with CORS, Uvicorn, and structured routing. | - React 18 (Vite) initialized with Tailwind CSS. | - SQLite local DB & SQLAlchemy ORM configured. | - CI/CD automated linting and pytest runners operational.
authenticate and obtain secure role-based session tokens (JWT)
sensitive administrative dashboards and reporting actions are restricted to authorized personnel.

- Public users can perform scans without login. | - Admin login with username/password issues signed JWT. | - Invalid credentials return HTTP 401 with informative error. | - Token expiry and refresh token mechanisms validated.
extract 21 lexical features from suspicious URLs and classify risk using HistGradientBoosting
the system detects malicious URLs, credential harvesters, and deceptive subdomain tricks instantly.

- Feature extraction pipeline extracts: URL length, entropy, IP address usage, punycode, hyphen count, sensitive tokens. | - HistGradientBoosting model (joblib) outputs calibrated risk score [0, 1]. | - Execution completes in < 250ms per URL query.
pre-filter input domains against official whitelist (.gov.vn, official banks) and known blacklists
benign government portals are never flagged falsely, and known malicious domains are blocked in 0ms.

- Whitelist check recognizes official banking/gov domains (Vietcombank, MB, gov.vn) and forces safe gating. | - Blacklist lookup matches known fraudulent domains and returns immediate risk level 100. | - Lookup overhead < 10ms.
analyze uploaded screenshots to detect counterfeit brand logos and deceptive visual layouts
visual phishing attempts mimicking popular banking apps or e-wallets are detected even without text.

- ResNet-18 CNN model processes image tensors (224x224). | - Temperature Scaling (T=1.8) applied to calibrate raw logits into smooth probabilities. | - Outputs brand classification confidence and visual fraud score.
apply Error Level Analysis (ELA) and EXIF metadata extraction on uploaded proof images
digitally manipulated images, fake bank transfer receipts, and edited logos can be flagged.

- ELA algorithm computes difference matrix between original and resaved JPEG. | - Identifies high-frequency anomalies in text areas (fake balance/billings). | - Extracts EXIF creation timestamps and camera/software signatures.
extract text content from uploaded screenshots and scam message captures
visual message evidence is converted into structured text for contextual linguistic risk evaluation.

- Tesseract OCR configured with 'vie+eng' language packs. | - Preprocessing pipeline: grayscale conversion, thresholding, noise removal. | - Outputs extracted plain text with character confidence metrics.
detect urgent, coercive, and fraudulent language patterns in Vietnamese text
scam scripts (mạo danh công an, đe dọa bắt giữ, nộp tiền phạt, khóa tài khoản) are pinpointed.

- Keyword lexicon covers: impersonation, financial urgency, OTP capture, high-yield investment traps. | - Regex matching extracts bank account numbers, OTP solicitations, and phone hotlines. | - Outputs normalized keyword risk score [0, 1].
combine URL lexical signals, visual brand detection, and OCR text semantics via multi-step CoT
the system reasons across all evidence sources to provide consistent, explainable fraud verdicts.

- Implements multi-step deductive inference (Step 1: Domain, Step 2: Visual, Step 3: Text, Step 4: Consensus). | - Soft Voting Consensus replaces crude max() function, preventing erratic 0% vs 98% jumps. | - Produces confidence-weighted final risk score.
receive clear, plain-language explanations of why a submission was deemed dangerous or safe
citizens without technical knowledge understand the specific deception techniques being used.

- System generates bulleted explanations (e.g., 'Phát hiện tên miền giả mạo', 'Hối thúc chuyển khoản khẩn cấp'). | - Explanations are synchronized with detected entities (brand, keywords, domain age). | - Vietnamese language output is grammatically natural and non-technical.
submit suspicious URLs, message text, and screenshots through a unified, responsive web portal
citizens can easily verify threats across mobile browsers or desktop PCs within seconds.

- Single-page application with 3 input modalities (URL input, Text area, Drag-and-drop Image upload). | - Real-time client-side validation and file format checks (JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 10MB). | - Loading skeleton and progress indicators during backend processing.
view an interactive breakdown of risk factors (Risk Gauge, Radar Chart, Actionable Advice)
I can make an immediate, informed decision whether to engage or discard the suspicious interaction.

- Tri-color Risk Gauge: Safe (0-39%), Suspicious (40-69%), Dangerous (70-100%). | - Radar chart showing risk distribution (Domain, Visual, Linguistic, Urgency). | - Specific, actionable safety recommendations ('Không cung cấp OTP', 'Liên hệ ngân hàng qua hotline chính thức').
review previous scan results and audit trails stored securely in my browser
I can re-read warning evidence without re-uploading sensitive files or re-running API scans.

- Inspection history persisted in browser localStorage (capped at 50 most recent records). | - Clear history button with confirmation dialog. | - Detailed modal view to reopen full reasoning breakdown for any past scan.
submit community feedback or report false positive / false negative scan verdicts
the system dataset can be continuously curated and audited by security engineers.

- 'Báo cáo sai lệch' modal on scan result screen. | - Captures user explanation, contact email (optional), and flagged classification error. | - Feedback record stored in database with pending audit status.
review reported incidents, inspect user feedback, and verify scam classifications
malicious threat campaigns can be validated and added to active protection lists.

- Admin view listing all citizen incident submissions with status filters (Pending, Reviewed, Dismissed). | - Detailed view displaying original inputs, AI scores, and user remarks. | - Action buttons to approve as confirmed scam or dismiss false alarm.
monitor overall system throughput, common scam categories, and detection accuracy KPIs
I have real-time visibility into prevailing fraud tactics and system operational health.

- Overview metrics: Total Scans, Confirmed Scams %, Average Response Time (ms), False Positive Rate. | - Time-series charts of daily scan volume and risk distribution. | - Top targeted brands leaderboard (e.g., Vietcombank, Techcombank, VNeID).
dynamically add, update, or remove domain rules, keywords, and trusted brand signatures
the system can instantly counter emerging zero-day phishing domains without redeploying code.

- CRUD interface for domain whitelist and blacklist. | - Add custom regex patterns and high-risk keywords with associated weight. | - Instant cache invalidation to reflect updates immediately in active inference.
Detailed Incident Audit Report Export (PDF / CSV)
export formal fraud investigation reports containing digital evidence and AI audit trail
citizens or legal authorities can use the standardized report as evidence for cybercrime complaints.

- Generates downloadable PDF report with timestamp, risk scores, forensic highlights, and prevention advice. | - Export tabular incident logs to CSV for external security analysis. | - Standardized header including DTU C1SE.06 verification signature.
Rate Limiting, Security Hardening & OWASP Compliance
implement API rate limiting, payload sanitization, and CORS security policies
the public-facing API is protected against DDoS attacks, automated scraping, and injection vectors.

- SlowAPI rate limiter restricts IP clients to 30 requests per minute. | - Strict file mime-type and magic-byte validation on image uploads. | - CORS configuration restricts allowed origins. | - SQL injection and XSS defenses verified via OWASP ZAP scanning.
End-to-End Stress Testing & Model Calibration Validation
conduct regression testing, load testing (50 concurrent users), and verify balanced score distribution
the deployed system operates stably, accurately, and reliably during Capstone final defense.

- Comprehensive pytest suite (unit, integration, multimodal reasoning) achieves > 85% coverage. | - Locust load test verifies p95 latency < 3.0s under 50 concurrent requests. | - Calibration test verifies no extreme 0%/98% bipolar spikes on ambiguous inputs.

paragraphs: Real-Time Retail Optimization Powered by edge AI
The following signatures are required for approval of this document.
The main goal of testing the StoreLens system is to ensure:
●	Reliable and accurate performance of Edge AI video processing (RTSP streams, YOLOv8, DeepSORT).
●	Stable data synchronization between Edge device – Backend – Dashboard (React).
●	Compatibility across browsers and operating systems.
●	Consistent real-time performance under expected network loads.
●	Smooth, intuitive user experience on the Admin Dashboard.
●	Minimum 90% of functional requirements verified and validated by the end of testing phase.
Add / edit / delete camera streams (RTSP URL).
Enable or disable detection per camera.
Process live camera feeds using YOLOv8.
Detect, track, and anonymize customer movements.
Send metadata (count, dwell time, zones) to backend.
View real-time occupancy, heatmap, and statistics.
Export daily/weekly statistics to CSV or PDF.
Login / Register: Account + Password form with validation.
Dashboard Home: Overview metrics, graphs, alerts.
Camera Management: Table view + camera card preview; add/edit form; ROI drawing panel.
Analytics Page: Heatmap visualization, bar charts of people counts, trends over time.
Console or local webpage to manage stream connection and system logs.
Unit Testing: Performed by developers for isolated functions and API endpoints.
System Testing: Validate the full workflow under realistic data streams.
Acceptance Testing: Validate requirements with mentor and stakeholders.
Black-box testing for user interface and functional validation.
Manual testing for UI, data display, and real-time video feedback.
Automated testing (Postman / Jest) for backend endpoints.
Exploratory testing to identify unexpected issues in live streaming integration.
Edge Device: NVIDIA Jetson Nano / Laptop with GPU
Network: LAN and Wi-Fi environment with variable latency.
All critical and high-priority functions (authentication, video detection, dashboard updates) must pass.
80% or higher test case pass rate required before delivery.
No High severity unresolved defects are allowed in release.
All test cases must be executed at least once before sprint closure.
Testing completion confirmed when all acceptance criteria in Product Backlog are satisfied.
Jira: Sprint task tracking & progress reporting
Gmail, Zalo, Discord: Daily communication and test coordination.
